name: identity
deployed_git_sha_detail: Inherited from the T21 Vercel frontend receipt; this task performed no deployment.
evidence_source: Steps performed by the owner's coordinator session 5ee80fcf on 2026-10-22 with owner approval; this receipt attests them, values never printed.

oauth-app.detail: GitHub OAuth App flow-remote (app id 3953415) was created under the owner account dav033 with homepage https://flow-remote.vercel.app and callback https://flow-remote.vercel.app/api/auth/callback, the frontend host required by remote/docs/runbook.md for the state cookie (not the gateway host). Its client id and a generated client secret were placed in the AdvIn gateway env file without printing. No other GitHub setting was touched.

telegram.detail: Bot @dav033_flow_bot (name Flow Remote) was created through BotFather by the coordinator with owner approval. getMe returned ok for that username and getChat returned ok for the owner's private chat after the owner account sent /start. The bot credentials were read only from the owner's secrets file and never printed.

generated-keys.detail: The gateway key and the session secret were generated on AdvIn with openssl rand -hex 48 (96 hex characters each). The same gateway key was mirrored to ~/.config/bitacora/remote.env on the laptop, mode 600, and the hashes of both copies were compared and match. Values never printed.

secrets-placement.detail: AdvIn /etc/flow-gateway/env is mode 600, owned by root, with timestamped backups kept; gateway key, session secret, GitHub client id and secret, Telegram bot token and chat id, and the frontend origin https://flow-remote.vercel.app are set (checked by presence only). LAPTOP_ORIGIN stays empty for T23. No Vercel env var was added: the frontend only needs GATEWAY_ORIGIN, which T23 sets.
